RFID payments may incur additional costs outside Electra's control and are not used as the direct reference tariff.
Published Italy table covers slow and fast AC-DC charging; no station-level dynamic pricing is stated for Italy in the current tariff article.
positiveEvidence: Electra tariff article dated 1 July 2026 explicitly binds the Italy row to 0.69 EUR/kWh via Electra app and 0.79 EUR/kWh by bank card at terminal.
The same article states the prices apply to Electra app, Autocharge and card-terminal sessions and separates possible RFID costs.
Current Electra+ documentation says variable prices concern France, Belgium and Spain; Italy is therefore not in the variable-pricing group.
